title: PARWAAN CHADHA LU'N KO! ARMAAN
body:
Parwaan chadha lu'n koi armaan nikalu'n
Thehro Ali Akbar Tumhe Dulha to banalu'n
Yu'n ghar se MereLaal ko le Jaae'n na Hazrat
Saaya kare aanchal ka Main Behno ko bulalu'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye LaalTere byaah ka Zainab ko tha armaan
In khoo'n bhare haatho'n meMain mehndi to lagalu'n
Shayad yu'nhi tham jaay lahu zakhme jigar ka
Utho Ali Akbar Main kaleje se lagalu'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Thehraao Janaaza Mujhe hasrat to na rehjaay
Taaboot pa phoolo'n ka MainSehra to chadhalu'n
Shawkat pa zara rehm kar aye maot theher ja
Aankhon se MazaareShahe Mazloom lagalu'n
author: Shoukat Bilgrami
